## Scope category
<!-- Check exactly one. -->
- [ ] Errata (typo, broken link, citation fix — no semantic change)
- [ ] Clarification (rewording for clarity — no semantic change)
- [ ] Crosswalk addition / update (requires accepted RFC)
- [ ] Control change (new or modified — requires accepted RFC)
- [ ] Methodology change (scoring algorithm — requires accepted RFC and minor version bump)
